children: The cost for freight fuel has risen about twice as fast as gasoline used by cars. The shock means higher shipping prices and inflation. Consumers have paid $112 bln more at the pump since the start of the Iran war. With refineries running at 97% capacity, the pain will get worse.
Full view will be published shortly.
US Senate Republican leader John Thune said on September 15 that he is open to exploring an export ban on diesel. Iowa Senator Chuck Grassley called for a ban on September 19.

The national average price of a gallon of diesel was $6.51 on September 21 according to the American Automobile Association, or 76% more than one year ago. The retail price for gasoline has risen 41% over the last year, to $4.48.
